responsibility: This is the main hand-written implementation file of the SPARC backend. It supplies the target hooks and helper routines that complement sparc.md: processor cost tables and scheduling/cost decisions for different SPARC cores; option, ABI, register, address, and mode-handling logic; expansion and output helpers for moves, calls, TLS/PIC, atomics, floating-point environment operations, VIS and builtins support; diagnostics and erratum-sensitive code generation; and other target callbacks such as constant alignment, cstore mode, mode-changing rules, and zeroing call-used registers, all of which consume GCC RTL/tree state and produce SPARC-specific lowering and assembly-generation behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the hand-written C implementation for the SPARC port’s runtime backend behavior and target hooks—e.g. cost tables, expansion/output helpers, builtin and floating-point-environment handling, and other target callbacks—whereas sparc.h provides compile-time target macros and policy, sparc.md provides the generated instruction-pattern/machine-description rules, and sparc.opt declares the target option metadata those hooks consume.
